parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description: The DNS resolution line, such as default, telecom, or mobile.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the weight configuration. Valid values:

- **true** (default): Enable

- **false**: Disable

parameters.name: SubDomain
parameters.description: The subdomain for which to configure weights. A primary domain name, such as example.com, is not valid. Use @.example.com instead.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the DNS record. Valid values: A and AAAA. Default value: A.

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the user.
